content: प्रच(चा)यः .²1 Collecting, gathering (as flowers); <ls>P. III. 3. 40</ls>. .²2 A multitude, quantity, collection, number; प्रसन्नः पुण्यानां प्रचय इव सर्वस्य सुखदः <ls>Mv. 2. 15</ls>. .²3 Growth, increase. .²4 Slight union. .²5 The neutral accentless tone (एकश्रुति). .²6 (In <ab>alg.</ab>) The common difference of terms in a progression.
